description: External literature ranges used as v2.24-v2.28 development regression checks. Parameters in these releases were adjusted against the checks, so they are not independent held-out validation.

historical_gmst_2011_2020_c.description: Observed global surface warming in 2011-2020 relative to 1850-1900.
historical_gmst_2011_2020_c.source_title: IPCC AR6 WGI Summary for Policymakers
historical_gmst_2011_2020_c.source_reference: IPCC AR6 WGI SPM, statement A.1.2
historical_gmst_2011_2020_c.notes: The full assessed likely range is retained rather than its central estimate. Used during v2.24-v2.28 development and structural calibration; do not describe this result as independent held-out validation.

historical_ocean_heat_content_change_197.description: Broad observed global-ocean heat gain over 1971-2018.
historical_ocean_heat_content_change_197.source_title: IPCC AR6 WGI Chapter 7, Earth energy inventory
historical_ocean_heat_content_change_197.source_reference: IPCC AR6 WGI Chapter 7, Section 7.2.2 and Table 7.1
historical_ocean_heat_content_change_197.source_location: Section 7.2.2: 282 ZJ for 1971-2006 plus 152 ZJ for 2006-2018; ocean share about 91%
historical_ocean_heat_content_change_197.notes: A deliberately broad range reflects inventory and period-combination uncertainty. Used during v2.24-v2.28 development and structural calibration; do not describe this result as independent held-out validation.

historical_arctic_amplification_1979_202.units: Arctic trend divided by global trend
historical_arctic_amplification_1979_202.source_title: The Arctic has warmed nearly four times faster than the globe since 1979
historical_arctic_amplification_1979_202.source_reference: Rantanen et al. 2022, Communications Earth & Environment, doi:10.1038/s43247-022-00498-3
historical_arctic_amplification_1979_202.source_location: Abstract and Results: near-fourfold amplification during 1979-2021
historical_arctic_amplification_1979_202.notes: The range is wider than the reported central ratio to accommodate definition differences. Used during v2.24-v2.28 development and structural calibration; do not describe this result as independent held-out validation.

ssp245_amoc_decline_2100_percent.description: Broad late-21st-century AMOC weakening envelope for an intermediate forcing pathway.
ssp245_amoc_decline_2100_percent.source_reference: IPCC AR6 WGI Chapter 4, AMOC projections across SSP scenarios
ssp245_amoc_decline_2100_percent.source_location: Section 4.3.2.3 and Figure 4.6: AMOC weakens in all scenarios with large model spread
ssp245_amoc_decline_2100_percent.notes: Broad software-regression envelope, not an observational probability interval. Used during v2.24-v2.28 development and structural calibration; do not describe this result as independent held-out validation.
